why: Searches turned up an active but ongoing literature of Sato-Tate generalizations (abelian varieties of GL_2-type, GL(2) automorphic forms over CM fields, specific curve families like y^l=x(x^l-1)), none of which claims to resolve a specific stated generalized conjecture; the original elliptic curve case was already proved before the snapshot.

found.title: Sato-Tate Groups and Distributions of y^l=x(x^l-1)
found.note: Determines Sato-Tate groups for a specific curve family, not a general resolution.

found.title: Monodromy groups and exceptional Hodge classes, II: Sato-Tate groups
found.note: Studies Sato-Tate groups via monodromy/Hodge classes for certain varieties.

found.title: Forum of Mathematics, Pi (2025) paper on Ramanujan and Sato-Tate conjectures for GL(2) over imaginary CM fields
found.note: Proves Ramanujan/Sato-Tate type results for a specific automorphic setting, not the general conjecture.
